spec.description: Threshold controlado pela variavel slow_ms. Favicon filtrado.

{service_name="hunter-web", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | scope_name="performance.request" | route != "/favicon.ico" | duration_ms > 5000 | line_format "[{{.method}}]  {{.route}}  ws={{.workshop_id}}  {{.duration_ms}}ms  status={{.status_code}}  q={{.query_count}}  sql={{.sql_time_ms}}ms  dep={{.dependency_time_ms}}ms  req={{.request_id}}"
